name: Vajra Sentinel Counter-Drone System

atlas_legacy_record.note: Values below come from the live legacy atlas page captured on 2026-09-02 and were NOT independently verified in this upgrade pass. They are carried forward for continuity only and must not be cited as evidence.

what_it_is: Vajra Sentinel is Big Bang Boom Solutions' AI-powered counter-drone system that detects RF-controlled commercial drones (DJI Mavic-class included) and neutralises them; trade press has reported its delivery to the Indian Air Force, and the companion Vajra Shot gun serves man-portable roles.
india_angle: Vajra Sentinel is one of the few Indian private C-UAS products with public delivery reporting to an Indian service (IAF, May 2025 trade reporting), making it a concrete data point in India's counter-drone industrialisation.
intelligence_assessment: The IAF delivery report is from trade press, not a government release; contract value and scale are undisclosed. Track MoD/IAF announcements and BBBS order-book disclosures for confirmation.

faq.q: Has Vajra Sentinel been delivered to the IAF?
faq.a: Trade press reported delivery in May 2025; a government release confirming quantities has not appeared.
